display_long_description:
Ultra Height: Skyscraper Free Climbing is a high-intensity VR height experience designed to deliver a powerful sense of scale, vertigo, and immersion.

We’ve been nominated for GAME OF THE YEAR 2026 for The Polys!

Send us your good luck and support 🚀


In this free game, you take on one extremely tall skyscraper, carefully designed to showcase the core gameplay, climb, fall and parachute gliding mechanics of the full experience.

🔹 What You’ll Experience

Climbing towering futuristic buildings and skyscrapers using full VR hand interaction

Walking on planks and pipes high up above the city

Navigate gondolas suspended high above the city

Feel the true sense of height as the ground disappears far below

Reach the summit and base jump from the top, deploy your parachute, and descend toward the city

Land in the town square, completing a full climb-to-jump vertical journey

🔹 A True Height Experience

This free edition focuses on:

Extreme vertical scale.

Fear of heights and spatial awareness.

Calm, precise climbing at dangerous altitude.

Designed as a standalone height challenge, this experience is perfect for players who want to test their nerves, enjoy climbing at massive scale, or experience the thrill of jumping from extreme heights in VR.
